newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Micron neutral repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Micron neutral repeated.

text.p: -- Gruntal said analyst Mona Eraiba retains her neutral rating of Micron Technology Inc.
-- said Micron could report second quarter earnings as high as $0.28 a share, exceeding Gruntal's estimate of $0.20 a share.
-- said expects improvement from strong increase in mega-bit shipments, improved DRAM prices and a decline in production costs.
-- said spot market DRAM prices probably peaked short-term.
-- said expects short-term profit taking when company reports earnings.
-- Shares were trading at 43-7/8, up 1-7/8 in late morning exchange trade.
